title: Rezoning to allow taller buildings near Crotona Parkway, Bronx
summary: This zoning map amendment would change part of a Bronx block from R7-1 and C1-4 districts to an R8 district with a new C2-4 commercial overlay, near East 182nd Street and Mapes Avenue in Community District 6. The change would allow an eight- to sixteen-story residential building at 2136 Crotona Parkway and a six- to fourteen-story mixed-use building with ground-floor community space nearby. It is paired with a related zoning text amendment designating the area for Mandatory Inclusionary Housing.
